bento.heading: Built for SlateJS
bento.subheading: Deeply embedded in Slate and works reliably as nodes are edited and restructured

items.answer: Yes. Velt anchors each comment to a path in the Slate document tree and rebases that anchor as nodes are split, merged, or restructured. Comments stay attached to the right content even after multi-user edits, formatting changes, or block reflows.
items.question: Will comments move as the document changes?

items.answer: Yes. The Velt SlateJS integration ships as a `withVeltComments` plugin that composes alongside `withReact`, `withHistory`, and any of your own `with*` plugins without overriding their schema, commands, or transforms. You can keep using any plugins you already have.
